title: limonium flexuosum
intro: Limonium flexuosum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Spurry, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Limonium flexuosum include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, due to its expectorant properties and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
